questions.text: Two colorless solutions are mixed. The result is still perfectly colorless and no bubbles or precipitate appear. Which is the most accurate conclusion?
options: The absence of visible signs does not rule out a chemical change
questions.explanation:
مشاهده‌ی پاسخ 
استدلال 
برخی واکنش‌های شیمیایی (مثل خنثی‌سازی اسید-باز شفاف) هیچ نشانه‌ی ظاهری ندارن. نبود نشانه، دلیل قطعی بر نبود واکنش نیست. 
پاسخ نهایی 
C.

questions.text: Which property explains why perfume can be smelled across a room shortly after the bottle is opened?
questions.explanation:
مشاهده‌ی پاسخ 
استدلال 
ذرات گازی عطر به‌سرعت در فضای اتاق پخش (نفوذ) می‌کنن — دقیقاً تعریف نفوذپذیری. 
پاسخ نهایی 
B.

questions.text: A water strider insect can walk on the surface of a pond without sinking. Which property is primarily responsible?
questions.explanation:
مشاهده‌ی پاسخ 
استدلال 
کشش سطحی، یه لایه‌ی «کشیده» روی سطح مایع می‌سازه که وزن سبک حشره رو تحمل می‌کنه. 
پاسخ نهایی 
C.

questions.text: Why does increasing pressure have almost no effect on the volume of a liquid, unlike a gas?
options: Liquid particles are already nearly touching, leaving little empty space to remove
Liquids are always denser than gases
questions.explanation:
مشاهده‌ی پاسخ 
استدلال 
گزینه‌ی A نامربوطه (بحث پیوند شیمیایی نیست، بلکه فاصله‌ی فیزیکیه). C و D ادعاهای نادرست یا نامرتبط‌ان. 
پاسخ نهایی 
B.

questions.text: Which of the following is a heterogeneous mixture?
questions.explanation:
مشاهده‌ی پاسخ 
استدلال 
روغن و آب مخلوط نمی‌شن و دو فاز مجزای قابل‌مشاهده می‌سازن. 
پاسخ نهایی 
C.

questions.text: Which separation method should be used to separate two miscible liquids with different boiling points?
questions.explanation:
مشاهده‌ی پاسخ 
استدلال 
تقطیر دقیقاً برای همین سناریو طراحی شده: از تفاوت نقطه‌جوش استفاده می‌کنه. 
پاسخ نهایی 
B.

questions.text: Milk appears completely uniform to the naked eye. Why is it still classified as heterogeneous?
options: It contains fat droplets suspended in water that can be seen with proper tools and can separate over time
questions.explanation:
مشاهده‌ی پاسخ 
استدلال 
معیار همگن‌بودن، یکنواختی در سطح مولکولیه، نه ظاهر چشمی. شیر یه کلوئیده (قدم ۲ رو ببین). 
پاسخ نهایی 
B.

questions.text: Which law states that mass is neither created nor destroyed in a chemical reaction?
questions.explanation:
مشاهده‌ی پاسخ 
پاسخ نهایی 
B.

questions.text: Hydrogen and oxygen react to form water vapor: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O. If 40 mL of oxygen reacts completely, what volume of hydrogen was used (same T, P)?
questions.explanation:
مشاهده‌ی پاسخ 
 قدم ۱ 
نسبت حجمی H₂ : O₂ = 2 : 1 
 قدم ۲ 
H₂ = 40 × 2 = 80 mL 
 پاسخ نهایی 
D.

questions.text: Two compounds contain only carbon and oxygen. Compound A has 3.00 g of oxygen per 1.00 g of carbon. Compound B has 1.50 g of oxygen per 1.00 g of carbon. Which law is illustrated, and what is the ratio?
questions.explanation:
مشاهده‌ی پاسخ 
 قدم ۱ 
کربن در هر دو ترکیب ثابت (۱ گرم) — پس می‌تونیم جرم‌های اکسیژن رو مستقیم مقایسه کنیم. 
 قدم ۲ 
3.00 : 1.50 = 2 : 1 
 پاسخ نهایی 
B. گای-لوساک فقط برای حجم گازهاست، نه جرم — گزینه‌ی C قانون اشتباهی رو نام برده.

questions.text: A sealed flask contains 2 L of helium and another sealed flask contains 2 L of carbon dioxide, both at equal temperature and pressure. Which statement is correct?
options: The flasks have equal numbers of particles but different masses
The CO₂ flask has fewer particles
This is impossible without knowing the flask shape
questions.explanation:
مشاهده‌ی پاسخ 
پاسخ نهایی 
B. آووگادرو تعداد ذره رو تضمین می‌کنه، نه جرم — CO₂ جرم مولی بیشتری از He داره.

questions.text: "John is at the movies or he is at the library." What kind of compound claim is this?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. کلمه‌ی «or» دو گزاره‌ی کامل («John is at the movies» و «he is at the library») رو به هم وصل کرده — این دقیقاً الگوی مشخص‌کننده‌ی یک disjunction است. نه عطفه (چون «and» نداره)، نه شرطیه (چون «if…then» نداره)، و چیزی هم نقیض نشده.

questions.text: "If it is not the case that Sara is late, then the meeting will start on time." Identify A (the antecedent) in symbolic terms.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. مقدم (antecedent) هر چیزیه که بین «If» و «then» قرار داره. اینجا «it is not the case that Sara is late» است — یعنی نقیضِ گزاره‌ی «Sara is late». گزینه‌ی A نقیض رو حذف می‌کنه؛ C و D هر دو نتیجه (consequent) رو با مقدم اشتباه می‌گیرن.

questions.text: "Dan will go to law school and become a priest, or he will travel the world." What is the outermost connective?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. جمله رو به‌صورت دو تکه‌ی بزرگ بخون: «[Dan will go to law school and become a priest]» or «[he will travel the world]». «and» واقعیه، ولی داخل تکه‌ی اول قرار داره — فقط «go to law school» و «become a priest» رو به هم وصل می‌کنه. ویرگول قبل از «or» یک نشونه‌ی قویه که «or» همون عملگریه که کل جمله رو در بر می‌گیره. این دقیقاً همون نوع ساختار تودرتوییه که آزمون برای تست پیدا کردن عملگر واقعیِ بیرونی استفاده می‌کنه — طبق همون Exam Tip بالا.

questions.text: "Ana plays the violin and the piano." Ana plays the violin (True). Ana does NOT play the piano (False). What is the truth value of the whole claim?
options: Depends on which instrument is mentioned first
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. «Ana plays the violin and the piano» یعنی «Ana plays the violin AND Ana plays the piano». چون بخش دوم غلطه، طبق جدول درستی «and»، کل گزاره غلط می‌شه — فارغ از اینکه بخش اول درست باشه.

questions.text: "The flight departed on time, but it landed late." Which pair of truth values for the two parts makes this whole claim TRUE?
options: Departed on time = False, Landed late = True
Departed on time = True, Landed late = True
Departed on time = True, Landed late = False
Departed on time = False, Landed late = False
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. «but» اینجا منطقاً «and» است، پس گزاره «Departed on time AND Landed late» است. طبق جدول درستی «and»، تنها حالتی که کل گزاره True می‌شه وقتیه که هر دو بخش True باشن. گزینه‌های دیگه هر کدوم حداقل یک بخش را False دارن.

questions.text: "Omar finished the report, submitted it on time, and informed his manager, but he forgot to attach the appendix." Exactly one of the four sub-claims in this sentence is false. Is the whole claim true or false, and why?
options: True, because most of the sub-claims are true
False, because it is a conjunction and one sub-claim is false
True, because "but" cancels out the earlier claims
Cannot be determined without knowing which sub-claim is false
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. این جمله چهار حلقه دارد که همه با «and» (یکی‌شون به‌شکل «but») به هم وصلن: finished the report / submitted it on time / informed his manager / attached the appendix (که در واقع «forgot to attach» یعنی این حلقه غلطه). طبق قانون عطف زنجیره‌ای، همین که یکی از چهار حلقه غلط باشه (فارغ از اینکه کدومه) کافیه کل گزاره غلط بشه. گزینه‌ی A دقیقاً همون دام «Question Trap» بالاست — درستیِ نسبی در منطق گزاره‌ای وجود نداره. گزینه‌ی D هم لازم نیست بدونی کدوم حلقه غلطه، چون در عطف، فقط تعداد حلقه‌های غلط (حداقل یکی) اهمیت داره، نه هویتشون.

questions.text: "You can pay by credit card or by bank transfer." A customer pays by credit card AND by bank transfer (splitting the amount). Assuming this is an inclusive or, is the original claim true or false?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. در فصل شمولی، وقتی هر دو طرف درست باشن (هم پرداخت با کارت، هم با انتقال بانکی)، طبق جدول درستی، کل گزاره همچنان True است. این دقیقاً ردیف اول جدول inclusive or است.

questions.text: "The number is either even or odd." We are told this exclusive-or claim is TRUE, and that "the number is even" is FALSE. What must be true about "the number is odd"?
options: It cannot be determined from this information.
It depends on whether the number is positive.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. طبق جدول درستی فصل استثنایی، تنها ردیف‌هایی که کل گزاره True می‌دن اونایی هستن که دقیقاً یکی از دو طرف درسته. چون "even" را False داریم و گزاره کلاً True است، طبق جدول تنها گزینه‌ی سازگار اینه که "odd" باید True باشه.

questions.text: "The delivery will arrive on Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday." This is an inclusive-style chain disjunction (the delivery could theoretically satisfy more than one description in a stretched sense, but here it refers to a single arrival day). We are told the whole claim is FALSE. What can we conclude?
options: The delivery arrived on at least one of the three days.
The delivery did not arrive on Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday.
The delivery arrived on exactly one of the three days.
The claim cannot be false under any circumstances.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. برای اینکه یک فصل زنجیره‌ای غلط باشه، طبق قانون قدم ۴، همه‌ی حلقه‌ها باید غلط باشن — یعنی نه دوشنبه، نه سه‌شنبه، نه چهارشنبه. گزینه‌ی A دقیقاً برعکس تعریف «غلط بودن فصل» است. گزینه‌ی C به فصل استثنایی مربوطه، نه به این مورد که یک روز تحویل واحده. این دقیقاً همون دام «Question Trap» بالاست: پرسیدن از حالت غلط، به‌جای حالت درست.

questions.text: "If the light is red, then cars must stop." A car sees a red light and stops. Is the conditional true or false in this case?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. مقدم (چراغ قرمزه) درسته و تالی (ماشین توقف کرد) هم درسته. طبق جدول درستی، ردیف اول (T,T) نتیجه‌اش True است.

questions.text: "If a metal is heated, then it expands." A piece of metal was NOT heated, and it did NOT expand. What is the truth value of the conditional in this case?
options: Cannot be determined without more information
The claim is irrelevant in this case
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. مقدم غلطه (فلز گرم نشده). طبق قانون قدم ۳ (درستیِ پوچ)، وقتی مقدم غلطه، شرطی همیشه درسته — فارغ از اینکه تالی چی شده. گزینه‌ی D اشتباهه چون شرطی هرگز «بی‌ربط» نمی‌شه؛ همیشه یک ارزش درستی مشخص داره.

questions.text: A company's policy states: "If an employee works more than 40 hours in a week, then the employee receives overtime pay." An employee worked 45 hours and did NOT receive overtime pay. Later, another employee worked 30 hours and also did NOT receive overtime pay. Which employee's case proves the policy claim FALSE?
options: Only the first employee (45 hours, no overtime pay)
Only the second employee (30 hours, no overtime pay)
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. کارمند اول: مقدم درسته (بیش از ۴۰ ساعت کار کرده) ولی تالی غلطه (اضافه‌کاری نگرفته) — این دقیقاً الگوی نقض‌کننده‌ی (T,F) است. کارمند دوم: مقدم غلطه (کمتر از ۴۰ ساعت کار کرده)، پس طبق قانون درستیِ پوچ، این مورد هیچ تناقضی با شرطی نداره — نداشتنِ اضافه‌کاری برای کسی که اصلاً بیش از ۴۰ ساعت کار نکرده، ادعای شرطی رو نقض نمی‌کنه. این تمرین دقیقاً همون دام رایج بالاست: قاطی کردن «مقدم غلط» با نقض شرطی.

questions.text: A = "The door is open." What is the correct contradictory of A?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. نقیض همیشه یعنی «not» + کل گزاره‌ی اصلی. گزینه‌های دیگه یا موضوع رو کلاً عوض کردن (پنجره به‌جای در) یا اطلاعات نامرتبط اضافه کردن (شکسته بودن، آینده).

questions.text: A = "The company's profit increased this quarter." Which statement is a CONTRARY of A, but NOT its contradictory?
options: "The company's profit did not increase this quarter."
"It is not true that the company's profit increased this quarter."
"The company's profit failed to increase this quarter."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. «decreased» و «increased» نمی‌تونن هم‌زمان هر دو درست باشن، ولی می‌تونن هر دو غلط باشن — مثلاً وقتی سود بدون تغییر مونده (نه افزایش، نه کاهش). این دقیقاً تعریف contrary است. گزینه‌های B، C و D همه شکل‌های مختلف همون «not increased» هستن که نقیض واقعیِ A محسوب می‌شن، چون هیچ حالت سومی رو باقی نمی‌ذارن.

questions.text: Consider: "The suspect was in the building at 9 PM, and the suspect was not in the building at 9 PM." Without knowing anything about the actual case, what is the truth value of this whole claim?
options: True, because one of the two parts must be true.
False, with certainty — no further information is needed.
Cannot be determined without more evidence.
True only if the suspect has an alibi.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. این گزاره دقیقاً به فرم «A and not-A» است — یک تناقض. طبق قدم ۵ و Quick Method این فصل، چنین گزاره‌ای همیشه غلطه، فارغ از هر شواهد یا اطلاعات بیرونی. گزینه‌ی C دقیقاً همون دامیه که این فصل هشدارش رو می‌ده: این نوع سؤالات هیچ‌وقت به «اطلاعات بیشتر» نیاز ندارن، چون ساختار منطقیشون به‌تنهایی جواب رو مشخص می‌کنه.

questions.text: Is the set consistent or inconsistent? "1. No birds can swim underwater for more than an hour. 2. Penguins can swim underwater for more than an hour."
options: Inconsistent, if penguins are considered birds.
Consistent, because penguins are unusual birds.
Consistent, because statement 1 only refers to "most" birds.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. اگه پنگوئن رو یک پرنده در نظر بگیریم، گزاره‌ی ۲ مستقیماً گزاره‌ی ۱ («No birds…») رو نقض می‌کنه — چون گزاره‌ی ۱ می‌گه هیچ پرنده‌ای نمی‌تونه، ولی گزاره‌ی ۲ می‌گه یک نوع پرنده (پنگوئن) می‌تونه. گزینه‌ی C اشتباهه چون گزاره‌ی ۱ کلمه‌ی «No» (یعنی هیچ) رو به‌کار برده، نه «most» (بیشتر).

questions.text: A set contains: "1. If it rained last night, the streets are wet. 2. It rained last night. 3. The streets are not wet." Is this set consistent or inconsistent?
options: Consistent — it's possible for rain not to make streets wet under some conditions.
Inconsistent — statements 1 and 2 together entail "the streets are wet," which contradicts statement 3.
Cannot be determined without visiting the location.
Consistent — statement 1 and statement 3 are only contraries, not contradictories.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. از گزاره‌های ۱ و ۲ — یک شرطی به‌همراه تأیید مقدمش — طبق قانون Modus Ponens (که در فصل ۱۲ کامل می‌بینیمش) نتیجه می‌گیریم «the streets are wet». این نتیجه مستقیماً نقیض گزاره‌ی ۳ است. طبق تعریف نقیض در فصل ۵، «wet» و «not wet» دقیقاً یکی درست و یکی غلطن (contradictory)، نه فقط contrary — پس گزینه‌ی D رد می‌شه. گزینه‌ی A هم واقعیت بیرونی رو قاطی منطق درونیِ خودِ سه گزاره کرده؛ درون این سیستم بسته، اگه ۱ و ۲ رو بپذیریم، دیگه راهی برای درست بودن ۳ باقی نمی‌مونه.

questions.text: What is the contradictory of "The package arrived on time and undamaged"?
options: "The package didn't arrive on time and it was damaged."
"The package didn't arrive on time, or it was damaged."
"The package arrived on time or undamaged."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. این یک عطفه؛ طبق قانون، نقیضش یک فصله از نقیضِ هر جزء. گزینه‌ی A دقیقاً همون اشتباه رایجه (عملگر رو عوض نکرده).

questions.text: What is the contradictory of "Either the printer is out of paper, or it is out of toner"?
options: "The printer is out of paper or out of toner."
"The printer is not out of paper, or it is not out of toner."
"The printer is not out of paper, and it is not out of toner."
"The printer is out of both paper and toner."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: C. این یک فصله؛ طبق De Morgan's Rules، نقیضِ فصل، یک عطفه از نقیضِ هر جزء. گزینه‌ی B عملگر رو عوض نکرده (هنوز «or» مونده). گزینه‌ی D اصلاً نقیض نیست، بلکه خودِ حالت مثبتِ هر دو جزئه.

questions.text: What is the contradictory of "If the invoice is approved, then payment is processed within 48 hours"?
options: "If the invoice is not approved, then payment is not processed within 48 hours."
"The invoice is not approved, and payment is not processed within 48 hours."
"The invoice is approved, and payment is not processed within 48 hours."
"If payment is not processed within 48 hours, then the invoice was not approved."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: C. طبق قدم ۴، نقیضِ «If A then B» همیشه «A and not-B» است — مقدم (تأیید فاکتور) دست‌نخورده می‌مونه و فقط تالی نقیض می‌شه. گزینه‌ی A دقیقاً همون دام «Question Trap» است — یک شرطیِ دیگه (inverse) که اصلاً نقیض نیست. گزینه‌ی D هم یک شرطیِ دیگه‌ست (contrapositive که در فصل ۸ می‌بینیم و در واقع با گزاره‌ی اصلی هم‌ارزه، نه نقیضش). گزینه‌ی B مقدم رو هم اشتباهاً نقیض کرده.

questions.text: "The alarm sounds if the temperature exceeds 50°C." Which is the correct standard form?
options: "If the temperature exceeds 50°C, then the alarm sounds."
"If the alarm sounds, then the temperature exceeds 50°C."
"The alarm sounds only if the temperature exceeds 50°C."
"Unless the temperature exceeds 50°C, the alarm sounds."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. طبق قدم ۱، «[جمله ۱] if [جمله ۲]» = «If [جمله ۲] then [جمله ۱]». چیزی که بعد از «if» اومده («temperature exceeds 50°C») مقدمه.

questions.text: "You may enter the lab unless you are not wearing safety goggles." Which is the correct standard form?
options: "If you are wearing safety goggles, then you may not enter the lab."
"If you are wearing safety goggles, then you may enter the lab."
"If you may enter the lab, then you are wearing safety goggles."
"You may enter the lab if and only if you are wearing safety goggles."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. فرم اصلی: «B unless A» = «If not-A then B». اینجا B = "you may enter the lab"، A = "you are not wearing safety goggles". پس: "If not-(you are not wearing safety goggles) then you may enter the lab" = "If you ARE wearing safety goggles, then you may enter the lab" (با استفاده از نقیض مضاعف فصل ۷). گزینه‌ی D ادعای اضافه‌ای (biconditional) می‌کنه که در جمله‌ی اصلی نیومده.

questions.text: "A shape is a square if and only if it has four equal sides and four right angles." A shape has four equal sides and four right angles, but we have NOT yet confirmed it is a square. Based only on this biconditional claim, can we conclude the shape is a square?
options: Yes — the 'if' direction B → A of the biconditional gives this conclusion.
No — a biconditional only works in one direction.
Cannot be determined — biconditionals never allow drawing conclusions.
Yes, but only if we also confirm the shape has four sides total.
questions.explanation: A iff B includes A→B and B→A. Given B, use B→A. The source labels this the 'only if' direction in its option; that wording was corrected.

questions.text: "Having a pulse is necessary for being alive." Which is the correct standard form?
options: "If a person has a pulse, then they are alive."
"If a person is alive, then they have a pulse."
"A person is alive if and only if they have a pulse."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. «necessary» یعنی تالیِ شرطیه. اینجا "having a pulse" برای "being alive" لازمه، پس: "If (alive) then (has a pulse)".

questions.text: "Scoring above 90% is sufficient to receive an A grade." A student scored 95% but did NOT receive an A (due to an unrelated academic misconduct penalty). Does this contradict the original claim?
options: Yes — the claim guarantees an A for any score above 90%, with no stated exceptions.
No — "sufficient" only means it's possible to get an A, not guaranteed.
No — academic misconduct is a necessary condition, so it overrides sufficiency.
Cannot be determined without knowing the full grading policy.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. «Sufficient» طبق تعریف یعنی «If A then B» بدون قید و شرط اضافه — یعنی نمره‌ی بالای ۹۰٪ به‌تنهایی باید A رو تضمین کنه. وقتی این اتفاق نمی‌افته، طبق جدول درستی فصل ۴ (مقدم درست، تالی غلط)، خودِ گزاره‌ی اصلی نقض شده. گزینه‌ی B معنای «sufficient» رو اشتباه، به‌عنوان «ممکنه» به‌جای «تضمین‌شده» تفسیر کرده.

questions.text: "Being a mammal is necessary for being a dog, but it is not sufficient." Which of the following best captures what this claim tells us?
options: Every dog is a mammal, but not every mammal is a dog.
No mammal can be a dog.
Being a mammal and being a dog are logically equivalent.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. «Being a mammal is necessary for being a dog» = «If (is a dog) then (is a mammal)» — یعنی هر سگی پستاندار است. «but not sufficient» یعنی «If (is a mammal) then (is a dog)» برقرار نیست — یعنی هر پستانداری لزوماً سگ نیست (مثل گربه یا فیل). گزینه‌ی D اشتباهه چون دقیقاً می‌گه رابطه یک‌طرفه‌ست، نه دوطرفه (iff)؛ اگه دوطرفه بود، «sufficient» هم برقرار می‌بود.

questions.text: What is the contradictory of "Some employees received a bonus this year"?
options: "All employees received a bonus this year."
"No employees received a bonus this year."
"Some employees did not receive a bonus this year."
"All employees did not receive a bonus this year."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. طبق قدم ۲، نقیضِ «Some A are B» همیشه «No A are B» است.

questions.text: "Only members with a gold pass can access the VIP lounge." Which is logically equivalent?
options: "All members with a gold pass can access the VIP lounge."
"Everyone who can access the VIP lounge has a gold pass."
"Some members with a gold pass cannot access the VIP lounge."
"No members with a gold pass can access the VIP lounge."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. «Only A are B» = «All B are A». اینجا A = "members with a gold pass"، B = "people who can access the VIP lounge". پس: "All (people who can access the VIP lounge) are (members with a gold pass)" = گزینه‌ی B.

questions.text: A company policy states: "Only senior engineers are authorized to approve deployments." An audit reveals: "Some deployments were approved by non-senior engineers." Does this audit finding contradict the policy statement?
options: Yes — the policy is logically equivalent to "All deployment-approvers are senior engineers," and the audit finding is exactly its contradictory.
No — the policy only restricts senior engineers, not deployments themselves.
Cannot be determined without knowing how many deployments were approved.
No — "only" statements cannot be contradicted by audit findings.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. "Only senior engineers are authorized to approve deployments" = "All (people who approve deployments) are (senior engineers)". طبق قدم ۱، نقیضِ این «All» گزاره، دقیقاً «Some (people who approve deployments) are not (senior engineers)» است — که همون چیزیه که یافته‌ی حسابرسی می‌گه. پس بله، این یافته مستقیماً سیاست رو نقض می‌کنه. گزینه‌ی B دقیقاً همون اشتباه رایج «Only ≠ All» است که در این فصل دیدیم.

questions.text: "No committee members voted against the proposal" is TRUE. What follows about "Some committee members voted against the proposal"?
options: It is true only if the vote was unanimous.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. «No A are B» و «Some A are B» رابطه‌ی قطری (contradictory) دارن. چون یکی درسته، اون یکی قطعاً غلطه.

questions.text: At least one flight operated. "All flights were delayed" is TRUE. What follows about "No flights were delayed"?
options: It is true only for international flights.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. «All A are B» و «No A are B» رابطه‌ی contrary دارن — نمی‌تونن هم‌زمان هر دو درست باشن. چون یکی («All flights were delayed») درسته، اون یکی («No flights were delayed») مجبوره غلط باشه. (این دقیقاً همون جهتِ قطعیِ contrary است — وقتی یکی درسته، اون یکی حتماً غلطه؛ برعکسش نامشخصه.)

questions.text: We only know: "Some reviewers approved the manuscript" is TRUE. Which of the following can we determine with certainty about "Some reviewers did not approve the manuscript"?
options: It must be true, since they are subcontraries.
It cannot be determined from this information alone.
It is automatically true if there are at least two reviewers.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: C. این دو گزاره رابطه‌ی subcontrary دارن. قانونِ subcontrary فقط جهت «هر دو نمی‌تونن غلط باشن» رو تضمین می‌کنه — یعنی اگه یکی غلط بود، اون یکی حتماً درسته. اما اینجا داریم گفته می‌شه یکی («Some…approved») درسته، نه غلط — و از درست بودنِ یکی از دو subcontrary، هیچ اطلاعاتِ قطعی‌ای درباره‌ی اون یکی به‌دست نمیاد (می‌تونه همه‌ی داوران تأیید کرده باشن، که در این صورت "Some did not approve" غلط می‌شه؛ یا بعضی تأیید نکرده باشن، که در این صورت درست می‌شه). گزینه‌ی A دقیقاً همون اشتباه رایج «اعمال قانون در جهتِ اشتباه» است.

questions.text: 1. If the server crashes, users lose their session. 2. The server crashed. What follows?
options: If users lose their session, the server crashes.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. این یک Modus Ponens ساده‌ست: مقدم («server crashes») درسته، پس تالی («users lose their session») هم قطعاً درسته.

questions.text: 1. If a candidate passes the interview, they receive an offer. 2. If a candidate receives an offer, they are added to payroll. Which conclusion is VALID?
options: "If a candidate is added to payroll, they passed the interview."
"If a candidate passes the interview, they are added to payroll."
"If a candidate does not pass the interview, they are not added to payroll."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. این دقیقاً Hypothetical Syllogism است — تالیِ گزاره‌ی ۱ («receive an offer») با مقدمِ گزاره‌ی ۲ یکیه، پس زنجیر می‌شن. گزینه‌ی A جهت رو برعکس کرده (دام رایج). گزینه‌ی D هم یک ادعای اضافه‌ست که مستقیماً از این دو گزاره نتیجه نمی‌شه (این در واقع همون inverse فصل ۷ است، نه چیزی که این دو گزاره تضمین کنن).

questions.text: 1. If a shipment clears customs, it is loaded onto the truck. 2. If a shipment is loaded onto the truck, it arrives within 3 days. 3. This shipment cleared customs. Which of the following can we conclude with certainty?
options: "This shipment did not arrive within 3 days."
"If this shipment arrives within 3 days, it cleared customs."
"This shipment was loaded onto the truck, but will not arrive within 3 days."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: C. اول با Hypothetical Syllogism، گزاره‌های ۱ و ۲ رو زنجیر می‌کنیم: "If a shipment clears customs, it arrives within 3 days." بعد چون گزاره‌ی ۳ می‌گه این محموله واقعاً گمرک رو رد کرده (مقدم درسته)، طبق Modus Ponens نتیجه می‌گیریم تالی («arrives within 3 days») هم قطعاً درسته. گزینه‌ی B جهت رو برعکس کرده — دقیقاً همون استنتاج نامعتبرِ این فصل. گزینه‌ی D هم خودش با نتیجه‌ی درستِ ما (C) در تناقضه.

questions.text: Consider the statement "No dog has three paws." Saying that it is false means that:
options: At least one dog has three paws.
At least one dog has a number of paws different from three.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. طبق قدم ۲، نقیضِ «∄x; p(x)» می‌شه «∃x; p(x)». نقیضِ «هیچ سگی سه‌پا نداره» یعنی «حداقل یک سگ سه‌پا داره» — نه ادعای بی‌ربطی درباره‌ی چهارپا بودن یا تعداد پاهای متفاوت.

questions.text: Saying that it's false that "no man has one name only" is equivalent to saying that:
options: At least one man has two names.
There exists a man named Mario.
There exists at least one man with one name only.
There exists a man without a name.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: C. "No man has one name only" یک گزاره‌ی ∄ است. طبق قدم ۲، نقیضش «∃x; p(x)» می‌شه — یعنی مستقیماً «حداقل یک مرد با فقط یک اسم وجود داره». گزینه‌های A، B و D همه ادعاهای اضافه یا نامرتبطی هستن که هیچ‌کدوم دقیقاً نقیضِ گزاره‌ی اصلی نیستن.

questions.text: The statement "It's not true that it is rainy and windy" means that:
options: It is not rainy, or it is not windy.
It is rainy and it is not windy.
It is not rainy and it is not windy.
It is not rainy and it is windy.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. این یک نقیضِ عطف ساده‌ست (فصل ۷)، نه یک گزاره‌ی کمّی، ولی دقیقاً همون منطقِ «and⇄or» رو نشون می‌ده که در کل این بخش دیدیم: not-(P and Q) = (not-P) or (not-Q). گزینه‌ی C دقیقاً همون اشتباه رایج هست — عملگر رو عوض نکرده و «and» رو نگه داشته.

questions.text: A bar chart shows website visits: Mon 200, Tue 350, Wed 280, Thu 400, Fri 310. On which day were the fewest visits recorded?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. ۲۰۰ کمترین مقدار بین همه‌ی روزهاست — یک سؤال ساده‌ی خوندنِ مستقیم مقدار.

questions.text: A bar chart shows annual production (in tons): Farm A: 2019=400, 2023=460. Farm B: 2019=150, 2023=210. Which farm had the larger ABSOLUTE increase in production?
options: Both had the same absolute increase.
questions.explanation: Farm A: 460−400=60 tons. Farm B: 210−150=60 tons. Both have the same absolute increase, so C is correct. The source's initial A label is a typo contradicted by its own calculation.

questions.text: A stacked bar chart shows total monthly sales split into "Online" and "In-Store." March: Online=60, In-Store=90 (Total=150). April: Online=100, In-Store=80 (Total=180). Which statement is correct?
options: In-Store sales increased from March to April.
Total sales increased, even though In-Store sales decreased.
Online sales decreased from March to April.
Total sales decreased from March to April.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. طبق قدم ۳، باید هر سری رو جدا بررسی کنیم: Online از ۶۰ به ۱۰۰ افزایش یافته (+40)، In-Store از ۹۰ به ۸۰ کاهش یافته (−10). مجموع کل از ۱۵۰ به ۱۸۰ افزایش یافته (+30) — یعنی با اینکه یکی از دو بخش کم شده، رشدِ بخشِ دیگه اون رو جبران کرده و مجموع رو هم بالا برده. این دقیقاً نشون می‌ده که نگاه کردن فقط به یک سری، بدون شکستنِ کامل ساختار نمودار انباشته، می‌تونه نتیجه‌ی گمراه‌کننده بده.

questions.text: A pie chart shows a class's favorite subjects: Math 30%, Science 25%, Art 20%, History 15%, Other 10%. If there are 40 students, how many chose Science?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. ۲۵٪ × ۴۰ = ۱۰.

questions.text: A pie chart shows a store's inventory by category. "Electronics" makes up 35% of inventory, and there are 210 electronic items. How many total items are in the inventory?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: C. کل = مقدار / درصد = ۲۱۰ / ۰.۳۵ = ۶۰۰.

questions.text: A pie chart shows a household's monthly spending: Rent 45%, Food 20%, Utilities 15%, Entertainment 10%, Savings 10%. This month, the amount spent on Food was €300. Next month, if the total budget increases by 20% but the percentage breakdown stays exactly the same, how much will be spent on Rent next month?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. اول کلِ فعلی رو پیدا کن: کل = ۳۰۰ / ۰.۲۰ = ۱,۵۰۰ یورو. کلِ ماه بعد با ۲۰٪ افزایش: ۱,۵۰۰ × ۱.۲۰ = ۱,۸۰۰ یورو. چون درصدِ اجاره (۴۵٪) ثابت مونده: ۴۵٪ × ۱,۸۰۰ = ۸۱۰ یورو. این سؤال دو مرحله داره — اول برگشت به کل از روی یک قطاع، بعد رفتن به قطاعِ دیگه با کلِ جدید.

questions.text: A line graph shows monthly rainfall (mm): Jan 40, Feb 55, Mar 30, Apr 60. Between which two consecutive months was the increase the largest?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: C. تفاضل‌ها: Jan→Feb: +15, Feb→Mar: −25, Mar→Apr: +30. بزرگ‌ترین افزایش بینِ مارس و آوریل (+30) اتفاق افتاده.

questions.text: A line graph tracks a stock price over 5 days: Day1=€50, Day2=€65, Day3=€40, Day4=€55, Day5=€45. What is the overall change from Day 1 to Day 5?
options: An increase of €15 (using the highest and lowest points)
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. «تغییرِ کلی از روز ۱ تا روز ۵» یعنی Day5 − Day1 = 45 − 50 = −5 (یعنی ۵ یورو کاهش). گزینه‌ی A دقیقاً همون اشتباهِ رایجه — به‌جای اول و آخر، بالاترین (۶۵) و پایین‌ترین (۴۰) رو با هم مقایسه کرده.

questions.text: A line graph shows a factory's weekly output (units) over 6 weeks: W1=100, W2=120, W3=90, W4=140, W5=130, W6=160. Which of the following is TRUE?
options: Output decreased overall from Week 1 to Week 6.
The sharpest single-week drop was larger than the sharpest single-week rise.
The overall trend is upward, despite a temporary dip in Week 3.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: C. تفاضل‌های پیاپی: W1→2: +20, W2→3: −30, W3→4: +50, W4→5: −10, W5→6: +30. با اینکه یک افتِ محلی در هفته‌ی ۳ داریم (−30)، روندِ کلی از ۱۰۰ به ۱۶۰ صعودیه — و اکثرِ تفاضل‌ها هم مثبت‌ان. گزینه‌ی A مستقیماً غلطه (۱۰۰ به ۱۶۰ که افزایشه). گزینه‌ی B غلطه چون بزرگ‌ترین افزایشِ پیاپی (+50) از بزرگ‌ترین افتِ پیاپی (−30) بزرگ‌تره. گزینه‌ی D هم غلطه — بالاترین مقدار در هفته‌ی ۶ (۱۶۰) است، نه هفته‌ی ۵ (۱۳۰).

questions.text: Claim: "Most customers rated the service as excellent." Data: 55 out of 100 customers rated it "excellent." Is the claim supported?
options: Yes, since 55% is more than half.
No, since 55% is not a large enough majority.
Yes, but only if the other 45% rated it "poor."
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: A. ۵۵٪ بیشتر از ۵۰٪ است، پس طبق تعریفِ «most»، ادعا تأیید می‌شه. گزینه‌ی D هم شرطِ اضافه‌ای گذاشته که در ادعا نیومده.

questions.text: Claim: "Every department reduced its budget this year." Data: Marketing −5%, Sales −3%, IT +2%, HR −8%. Is the claim supported?
options: Yes, because most departments show a decrease.
Cannot be determined without more data.
Yes, since the average change across departments is still negative.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. ادعا از «every department» صحبت کرده — یک ادعای «all». همینِ یک استثنا (IT با +۲٪) کافیه که کل ادعا رد بشه، فارغ از اینکه میانگین یا اکثریت چی نشون بده.

questions.text: Data: In a survey of 500 people, 150 people own a car and 80 people own a bicycle. Which statement MUST be true?
options: At least 30 people own both a car and a bicycle.
More people own a car than own a bicycle.
Exactly 270 people own neither a car nor a bicycle.
No one owns both a car and a bicycle.
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. ۱۵۰ > ۸۰ مستقیماً و بدونِ هیچ فرضِ اضافه‌ای از خودِ اعداد نتیجه می‌شه. گزینه‌های A و D هر دو درباره‌ی هم‌پوشانیِ این دو گروه فرض می‌کنن — که هیچ‌جا داده نشده؛ چون ۱۵۰+۸۰=۲۳۰ کمتر از کلِ ۵۰۰ نفره، اصلاً هم‌پوشانی اجباری نیست (می‌تونه صفر باشه، یا هر عددی تا ۸۰). گزینه‌ی C هم دقیقاً همون فرضِ «هیچ هم‌پوشانی‌ای نیست» رو داره که تضمین‌شده نیست.

questions.text: In a group of 60 people, 35 speak English, 30 speak French, and 10 speak neither. How many speak both languages?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. حداقل یکی = ۶۰−۱۰=۵۰. معادله: ۳۵+۳۰−x=۵۰ ⟹ ۶۵−x=۵۰ ⟹ x=۱۵.

questions.text: A company has 120 employees. 70 work remotely at least one day a week, 55 use a company car, and 25 do both. How many employees do NEITHER (never work remotely AND never use a company car)?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: C. حداقل یکی = ۷۰+۵۵−۲۵=۱۰۰. هیچ‌کدام = ۱۲۰−۱۰۰=۲۰.

questions.text: In a survey of 200 people, 45 like ONLY tea (not coffee), 60 like ONLY coffee (not tea), and 35 like neither. How many people like BOTH tea and coffee?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: C. اینجا اعدادِ داده‌شده «فقط تی» و «فقط قهوه» هستن، نه |A| و |B| کامل — دقیقاً همون دامِ این فصل. باید از فرمولِ اصلی استفاده کنیم: کل = فقط تی + فقط قهوه + هر دو + هیچ‌کدام. پس: ۲۰۰ = ۴۵ + ۶۰ + هر دو + ۳۵ ⟹ هر دو = ۲۰۰−۱۴۰ = ۶۰.

questions.text: The sum of two numbers is 60. The first number is 12 more than the second. What is the second number?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. فرض کن دومی=N، اولی=N+12. N+(N+12)=60 ⟹ 2N=48 ⟹ N=24.

questions.text: Three siblings have a combined age of 54. Emma is twice as old as Liam. Liam is 3 years younger than Noah. If Liam's age is L, which equation correctly represents the total?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: B. Emma = 2L (دو برابرِ لیام). "Liam is 3 years younger than Noah" یعنی Liam = Noah−3، پس Noah = Liam+3 = L+3. جمعِ کل: L + 2L + (L+3) = 54. گزینه‌ی A جهتِ رابطه‌ی Noah رو برعکس کرده — دقیقاً همون دامِ رایجِ این فصل.

questions.text:
Find the price of three items — X, Y, Z — given: 
 • Price of 1 X and 2 Y: 32 
 • Price of 2 Y and 1 Z: 28 
 • Price of 1 X and 1 Z: 20 
 What is the price of Y?
questions.explanation:
نمایش پاسخ و توضیح 
 پاسخ درست: C. معادلات: (۱) X+2Y=32، (۲) 2Y+Z=28، (۳) X+Z=20. از (۱): X=32−2Y. جایگذاری در (۳): (32−2Y)+Z=20 ⟹ Z=2Y−12 (معادله‌ی ۴). جایگذاریِ (۴) در (۲): 2Y+(2Y−12)=28 ⟹ 4Y−12=28 ⟹ 4Y=40 ⟹ Y=10. چک نهایی: X=32−20=12، Z=2(10)−12=8. جایگذاری در (۲): 2(10)+8=28 ✓. در (۳): 12+8=20 ✓. همه‌ی معادلات جور در میان.

questions.text: Which of the following is a vector quantity?
questions.explanation:
1یادآوری 
برداری = اندازه + جهت. 
2بررسی 
جرم، زمان و تندی فقط اندازه دارند؛ جابه‌جایی جهت هم دارد. 
✅ پاسخ: D) Displacement

questions.text: The SI base unit for electric current is:
questions.explanation:
1بررسی 
در جدول هفت‌تایی SI، جریان = آمپر. ولت، کولن و اهم مشتق‌اند. 
✅ پاسخ: C) Ampere

questions.text: A force of 15 N acts on a mass of 5 kg. What is the acceleration?
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
a = F/m 
2جایگذاری 
a = 15/5 = 3 m/s² 
✅ پاسخ: B) 3 m/s²

questions.text: Which pair contains one scalar and one vector quantity?
questions.explanation:
1هر کمیت را دسته‌بندی کن 
سرعت، شتاب، نیرو، تکانه = برداری؛ مسافت و تندی = نرده‌ای. 
2جفت‌ها 
A: هر دو برداری. B: هر دو نرده‌ای. C: هر دو برداری. D: تندی (نرده‌ای) + تکانه (برداری) ✔ 
✅ پاسخ: D) Speed and Momentum

questions.text: The pascal in SI base units is:
questions.explanation:
1تعریف 
Pa = N/m² 
2جایگذاری 
(kg m s⁻²)/m² = kg m⁻¹ s⁻² 
✅ پاسخ: B) kg m⁻¹ s⁻²

questions.text: The number of seconds in one day is approximately:
Which graph represents inverse proportionality?
questions.explanation:
1رابطه 
y = k/x 
2شکل 
نمودار آن هذلولی است. 
✅ پاسخ: C) Hyperbola

questions.text: A cyclist travels 180 m in 12 s. Its speed is:
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
v = d/t 
2جایگذاری 
180/12 = 15 m/s 
✅ پاسخ: B) 15 m/s

questions.text: The horizontal component of a 20 N force at 30° to the horizontal is:
questions.explanation:
1مؤلفهٔ افقی = مجاور 
Fx = F cosθ 
2جایگذاری 
20 × cos30° = 20 × 0.866 = 17.32 N 
✅ پاسخ: B) 17.32 N

questions.text: A ruler has a 1 mm resolution. Which reading could it report for a length?
questions.explanation:
1رزولوشن 
۱ mm = ۰٫۱ cm؛ پس خواندن تا یک رقم اعشار بر حسب cm معنی دارد. 
2بررسی 
۱۲٫۳ cm ✔؛ بقیه دقتی می‌دهند که خط‌کش ندارد. 
✅ پاسخ: B) 12.3 cm

questions.text: Convert 64 mg to grams.
Two forces of 8 N (East) and 6 N (North) act on a body. The magnitude of the resultant is:
questions.explanation:
1مؤلفه‌ها 
عمود بر هم‌اند. 
2فیثاغورس 
R = √(8² + 6²) = √100 = 10 N 
✅ پاسخ: B) 10 N

questions.text: Which is a systematic error?
options: A balance that always reads 5 g too high
Variable reaction time with a stopwatch
questions.explanation:
1معیار 
سیستماتیک یعنی هر بار یک‌جور و تکرارشونده. 
2بررسی 
گزینهٔ B هر بار +۵ g می‌دهد؛ بقیه هر بار فرق می‌کنند. 
✅ پاسخ: B

questions.text: A ball is thrown upward. At the highest point:
options: v and a are both zero
questions.explanation:
1سرعت 
در اوج جهت حرکت عوض می‌شود، پس v لحظه‌ای صفر است. 
2شتاب 
گرانش هنوز اثر می‌کند: a = 9.8 m/s² رو به پایین. 
✅ پاسخ: B

questions.text: An object moves from x₁ = 3 m to x₂ = −4 m. What is its displacement?
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
Δx = x₂ − x₁ 
2محاسبه 
−4 − 3 = −7 m 
✅ پاسخ: B) −7 m

questions.text: A cyclist rides at 6 km/h. What is this in m/s?
questions.explanation:
1قاعده 
km/h ÷ 3.6 
2محاسبه 
6/3.6 ≈ 1.67 m/s 
✅ پاسخ: B) 1.67 m/s

questions.text: A car accelerates from rest to 20 m/s in 4 s. What is its acceleration?
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
a = Δv/Δt = 20/4 = 5 m/s² 
✅ پاسخ: B) 5 m/s²

questions.text: If velocity and acceleration have opposite signs, the object is:
questions.explanation:
1قاعده 
مخالف‌علامت ⇒ کندشونده. 
✅ پاسخ: B) slowing down

questions.text: A particle is at x = −3 m at t = 0, x = 9 m at t = 4 s (extra info), and x = 15 m at t = 6 s. Magnitude of the average velocity over the 6 s?
questions.explanation:
1فقط ابتدا و انتها 
Δx = 15 − (−3) = 18 m 
2تقسیم 
v̄ = 18/6 = 3 m/s 
✅ پاسخ: B) 3 m/s

questions.text: x = t² − 4t + 5 (SI). How many direction changes for t ≥ 0?
questions.explanation:
1مشتق 
v = 2t − 4 
2ریشه 
t = 2 s ≥ 0 ✔ 
3علامت 
قبل از ۲ منفی و بعد از ۲ مثبت ← یک تغییر. 
✅ پاسخ: B) 1

questions.text: x = t² + 2t + 3 (SI). How many direction changes for t ≥ 0?
questions.explanation:
1مشتق 
v = 2t + 2 
2ریشه 
t = −1 (نامعتبر) 
3نتیجه 
v همیشه مثبت است. 
✅ پاسخ: A) 0

questions.text: A car goes from 10 m/s to 25 m/s over 175 m. Its acceleration?
questions.explanation:
1زمان نیست 
v₂² − v₁² = 2aΔx 
2جایگذاری 
625 − 100 = 2a(175) 
3حل 
525 = 350a → a = 1.5 m/s² 
✅ پاسخ: B) 1.5 m/s²

questions.text: A ball dropped from rest takes 2 s to land (g = 10). Height?
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
h = ½gt² = ½(10)(4) = 20 m 
✅ پاسخ: B) 20 m

questions.text: A particle moves on a circle of radius 8 m with period 4 s. Centripetal acceleration?
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
a_c = 4π²r/T² 
2جایگذاری 
4π²(8)/16 = 2π² m/s² 
✅ پاسخ: C) 2π² m/s²

questions.text: v = (t − 5)² (SI). Which statement is correct?
options: Direction changes once at t = 5 s
Speed at t = 3 s differs from t = 7 s
Average acceleration from 4 s to 5 s is 5 m/s²
questions.explanation:
1علامت v 
(t−5)² ≥ 0، پس جهت هرگز عوض نمی‌شود. 
2بررسی C 
v(3) = 4 , v(7) = 4 (برابر) 
3بررسی D 
v(4)=1 , v(5)=0 → a = −1 (نه ۵) 
✅ پاسخ: B

questions.text: A car accelerates from rest at 2 m/s² for 5 s, moves at constant speed for 10 s, then brakes at 5 m/s² to stop. Total distance?
Car A (25 m/s) is 150 m behind car B (15 m/s), same direction. Time to catch up?
questions.explanation:
1سرعت نسبی 
25 − 15 = 10 m/s 
2زمان 
150/10 = 15 s 
✅ پاسخ: C) 15 s

questions.text: Which quantity is invariant under a Galilean transformation between inertial frames?
questions.explanation:
1مکان و سرعت 
به دستگاه بستگی دارند. 
2سرعت نور 
در گالیله ثابت نمی‌ماند (نتیجهٔ نسبیت خاص است). 
3زمان 
t = t′ ✔ 
✅ پاسخ: D) Time interval

questions.text: A 20 N force acts at 60° to a 5 m displacement. The work is:
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
W = Fd cosθ 
2محاسبه 
20×5×0.5 = 50 J 
✅ پاسخ: B) 50 J

questions.text: A 3 kg object accelerates at 4 m/s². The net force is:
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
F = ma = 3×4 = 12 N 
✅ پاسخ: D) 12 N

questions.text: A spring with k = 150 N/m is stretched 0.2 m. The force is:
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
F = kx = 150×0.2 = 30 N 
✅ پاسخ: B) 30 N

questions.text: A 2000 kg elevator moves down while decelerating at 2 m/s² (g = 10). The cable tension is:
questions.explanation:
1جهت شتاب 
رو به بالا. 
2فرمول 
T = m(g + a) = 2000×12 = 24000 N 
✅ پاسخ: C) 24000 N

questions.text: A 60 kg box is pulled by a horizontal 300 N force, μk = 0.3 (g = 10). Acceleration?
questions.explanation:
1اصطکاک 
f_k = 0.3×600 = 180 N 
2شتاب 
a = (300 − 180)/60 = 2 m/s² 
✅ پاسخ: C) 2 m/s²

questions.text: An engine delivers 60 kW at a constant 20 m/s. The resistive force is:
A pump uses 5000 J to lift 40 kg of water 8 m (g = 10). Efficiency?
questions.explanation:
1مفید 
mgh = 3200 J 
2بازده 
3200/5000 = 64% 
✅ پاسخ: C) 64%

questions.text: A 4 kg object speeds up from 3 m/s to 5 m/s. Work done?
A skier leaves a jump at 20 m/s (no losses, g = 10). Where is the speed 12 m/s?
questions.explanation:
1پایستگی 
½(144 − 400) + 10Δh = 0 
2حل 
−128 + 10Δh = 0 → Δh = +12.8 m 
3تفسیر 
سرعت کم شده ⇒ بالاتر رفته. 
✅ پاسخ: A) 12.8 m higher

questions.text: Masses 3×10²⁴ kg and 2×10²² kg are 2×10⁷ m apart. The gravitational force is about:
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
F = Gm₁m₂/r² 
2محاسبه 
6.67×10⁻¹¹×6×10⁴⁶ / 4×10¹⁴ ≈ 1.0×10²² N 
✅ پاسخ: A) 1.0×10²² N

questions.text: A 0.2 kg ball moving right at 8 m/s hits a wall and returns left at 5 m/s. Contact time 0.05 s. Average force?
questions.explanation:
1جهت مثبت 
راست مثبت: v₁ = +8, v₂ = −5 
2Δp 
0.2(−5 − 8) = −2.6 kg m/s 
3نیرو 
F = 2.6/0.05 = 52 N 
✅ پاسخ: C) 52 N

questions.text: At height h = Rₑ above Earth, g′ equals:
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
g′ = (Rₑ/2Rₑ)² g = g/4 
✅ پاسخ: B) g/4

questions.text: A 0.9 kg mass moves in a horizontal circle of radius 1.0 m, one revolution per second. Centripetal force?
questions.explanation:
1تندی 
v = 2π(1)/1 = 2π m/s 
2نیرو 
F = mv²/r = 0.9×4π² = 3.6π² N 
✅ پاسخ: C) 3.6π² N

questions.text: A 1000 kg car takes a flat curve (r = 50 m) at 10 m/s. The minimum μs is:
A force of 450 N acts on 0.3 m². The pressure is:
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
P = F/A = 450/0.3 = 1500 Pa 
✅ پاسخ: B) 1500 Pa

questions.text: A 1.2 kg object has a volume of 5×10⁻⁴ m³. Its density is:
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
ρ = m/V = 1.2/(5×10⁻⁴) = 2400 kg/m³ 
✅ پاسخ: C) 2400 kg/m³

questions.text: Points at the same depth in the same connected static liquid have:
questions.explanation:
1قاعده 
هم‌عمق در همان مایع متصل ⇒ هم‌فشار. 
✅ پاسخ: A) equal pressure

questions.text: A hydraulic press: small piston 8 cm², large 320 cm², force 50 N on small piston. Force on large piston?
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
F₂ = F₁(A₂/A₁) = 50×(320/8) = 2000 N 
✅ پاسخ: D) 2000 N

questions.text: A mercury barometer reads 70 cm. As a fraction of standard 76 cmHg, this is:
questions.explanation:
1محاسبه 
70/76 ≈ 0.92 
✅ پاسخ: B) 0.92 atm

questions.text: A block of density 750 kg/m³ floats in oil of density 900 kg/m³. Fraction submerged?
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
V_sub/V = ρ_block/ρ_oil = 750/900 ≈ 0.83 
✅ پاسخ: C) 0.83

questions.text: Water narrows from 20 cm to 5 cm diameter. If speed in the narrow part is 32 m/s, the speed in the wide part is:
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
v_wide = v_narrow (d_narrow/d_wide)² = 32×(5/20)² = 2 m/s 
✅ پاسخ: B) 2 m/s

questions.text: A gas manometer: mercury on the gas side is 6 cm higher than the open side; atmosphere = 76 cmHg. Gas pressure?
questions.explanation:
1تحلیل 
جیوهٔ سمت گاز بالاتر ⇒ فشار گاز کمتر از جو. 
2فرمول 
P_gas = 76 − 6 = 70 cmHg 
✅ پاسخ: A) 70 cmHg

questions.text: A cylindrical tank (base 250 cm²) holds liquid of density 950 kg/m³ to height 60 cm, sealed with extra gas pressure 2000 Pa above it (g = 10). Total force on base?
questions.explanation:
1فشار کل 
P = ρgh + P_extra = 5700 + 2000 = 7700 Pa 
2نیرو 
F = P×A = 7700×0.025 = 192.5 N 
✅ پاسخ: C) 192.5 N

questions.text: Two points in the atmosphere differ in altitude by 1500 m (average air density 1.1 kg/m³, g = 10). Pressure difference?
questions.explanation:
1فرمول 
ΔP = ρgΔh = 1.1×10×1500 = 16500 Pa 
✅ پاسخ: B) 16.5 kPa

questions.text: A hole is 0.8 m below the surface of an open water tank (g = 10). The exit speed is:
questions.explanation:
1توریچلی

questions.text: How many unordered pairs can be selected from 6 people?
questions.explanation: Use C(n,2)=n(n−1)/2 because order does not matter.

questions.text: A fair die is rolled. What is the probability of a result at most 4?
questions.explanation: There are n favorable equally likely outcomes out of six.

questions.text: P(A)=0.4, P(B)=0.3 and A,B are mutually exclusive. Find P(A or B).
questions.explanation: For disjoint events, P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B).

questions.text: Among 8 red balls, 4 are marked. Given that a selected ball is red, what is the probability it is marked?
questions.explanation: Conditioning restricts the sample space to the red balls.

questions.text: A study selects 400 residents from a city of 50,000. The selected residents form the:
questions.explanation: A sample is the subset actually observed, while the population is the whole city.

questions.text: A value occurs 4 times in a dataset of 10 observations. What is its relative frequency?
questions.explanation: Divide the absolute frequency by the total number of observations.

questions.text: A pie-chart category represents 40% of observations. What is its central angle in degrees?
questions.explanation: A full circle is 360°; multiply the proportion by 360.

questions.text: Find the arithmetic mean of 4, 6, 8.
questions.explanation: Add the values and divide by three.

questions.text: Find the range of 4, 7, 12.
questions.explanation: Range = maximum − minimum.

questions.text: Two supplementary angles are 80° and x°. Find x.
questions.explanation: Supplementary angles sum to 180°.

questions.text: A triangle has base 8 and perpendicular height 5. Find its area.
questions.explanation: Triangle area is one half × base × height.

questions.text: What is the area of a circle of radius 4?
questions.explanation: Circle area is πr², whereas circumference is 2πr.

questions.text: A rectangular cuboid has dimensions 4, 3 and 5. Find its volume.
questions.explanation: Multiply the three perpendicular side lengths.

questions.text: The side lengths of two similar figures have scale factor 4. What is the ratio of their areas?
questions.explanation: Areas scale with the square of the linear scale factor.

questions.text: Convert 120° to radians.
questions.explanation: Multiply degrees by π/180; equivalent unsimplified fractions are allowed in the correct option.

questions.text: A right triangle has opposite side 12, adjacent side 16, hypotenuse 20. Find sin θ.
questions.explanation: Sine is opposite divided by hypotenuse.

questions.text: Which quadrant contains an angle of 240°?
questions.explanation: An angle strictly between 180° and 270° lies in quadrant III.

questions.text: For θ=40°, simplify sin(180°−θ).
questions.explanation: Angles supplementary to θ have the same sine.

questions.text: If sin θ=4/5 and cos θ is positive, what is sin(2θ) in terms of cos θ? Give the coefficient multiplying cos θ.
questions.explanation: Use sin(2θ)=2sinθcosθ.

questions.text: How many solutions does sin x=0 have in [0,4π]?
questions.explanation: The solutions are integer multiples of π, including both endpoints.

questions.text: What is the maximum value of f(x)=4sin x+1?
questions.explanation: Since sin x≤1 and the amplitude is positive, the maximum is n+1.

questions.text: Find the real domain of f(x)=√(x−4).
questions.explanation: The radicand of a real square root must be nonnegative.

questions.text: Which function is the inverse of f(x)=4^x?
questions.explanation: Logarithms undo exponentiation with the same positive base different from 1.

questions.text: Find the x-coordinate of the vertex of y=x²−8x+1.
questions.explanation: The vertex has x=−b/(2a).

questions.text: Solve |x|=4.
questions.explanation: Absolute value is distance from zero, giving both symmetric values.

questions.text: What value must be excluded from the domain of f(x)=1/(x−4)?
questions.explanation: A rational expression is undefined where its denominator is zero.

questions.text: Solve 2^x=16.
questions.explanation: Express both sides with base 2 and equate exponents.

questions.text: Evaluate log_4(16).
questions.explanation: The logarithm asks which exponent gives the argument; n² is n raised to 2.

questions.text: Relative to y=x², y=(x−4)² is shifted:
questions.explanation: Replacing x with x−a translates a graph a units right.

questions.text: If f(x)=2x+1 and g(x)=x², find f(g(4)).
questions.explanation: Evaluate the inner function g first, then apply f.

questions.text: The graph of y=x²−16 lies below the x-axis for:
questions.explanation: Below the x-axis means y<0; the upward parabola is negative between its roots.

questions.text: A length measurement is reported as '6 metres'. What are the two essential parts of the measurement?
options: A numerical value and a unit
questions.explanation: A physical quantity is expressed as a numerical magnitude multiplied by an agreed unit.

questions.text: What are the dimensions of speed v=s/t?
questions.explanation: Substitute dimensions of mass M, length L and time T into the defining relation.

questions.text: Which measurement requires a direction as well as its numerical value: scenario 2 with an object travelling along a straight road?
questions.explanation: Velocity is a vector; mass, elapsed time and energy are scalars.
Multiply coefficients and add powers of ten.

questions.text: A model has y=k/x². If x becomes 2 times as large, by what factor does y change?
questions.explanation: Inverse-square dependence gives a factor 1/n².

questions.text: Perpendicular vectors have magnitudes 6 and 8. Find the magnitude of their sum.
questions.explanation: Use the Pythagorean theorem for perpendicular components.

questions.text: A ruler's smallest division is 0.2 cm. What is its resolution in millimetres?
questions.explanation: Multiply centimetres by 10 to obtain millimetres.

questions.text: A balance always reads 2 g too high. Which change directly corrects this error?
options: Round every reading to an integer
questions.explanation: A persistent offset is systematic; repeating an uncalibrated measurement does not remove it.

questions.text: An object goes from x=2 m to x=9 m, then returns to x=4 m. Find the total displacement in metres.
questions.explanation: Displacement uses final position minus initial position, not total path length.

questions.text: A runner completes a 200 m trip in 20 s. Find average speed in m/s.
questions.explanation: Average speed is total distance divided by total time.

questions.text: Uniform motion starts at x₀=3 m with velocity 2 m/s. Find x after 5 s in metres.
questions.explanation: For uniform rectilinear motion, x=x₀+vt.

questions.text: An object is at x=−2 m and has velocity +3 m/s. Which statement is correct?
options: It is right of the origin and moving in the negative direction
It must be moving away from the origin
It is left of the origin and moving in the positive direction
questions.explanation: The position sign gives location; the velocity sign gives direction. Speed is nonnegative.

questions.text: Velocity increases from 2 to 14 m/s in 3 s. Find average acceleration in m/s².
questions.explanation: Average acceleration is Δv/Δt.

questions.text: A position–time graph is the line x=2t+4 (SI). What is the velocity in m/s?
questions.explanation: The slope of a position–time graph is velocity.

questions.text: A velocity–time graph is horizontal at 2 m/s from t=0 to t=6 s. Find the displacement in metres.
questions.explanation: Displacement is the signed area under the velocity–time graph.

questions.text: Acceleration is constant at 2 m/s² for 4 s. What is the change in velocity in m/s?
questions.explanation: Change in velocity is the area under the acceleration–time graph.

questions.text: An object starts from rest and accelerates at 2 m/s² for 4 s. Find distance in metres.
questions.explanation: From rest, s=at²/2.

questions.text: A ball is dropped from rest for 2 s. Neglect air resistance and use g=10 m/s². Find its downward speed in m/s.
questions.explanation: Under constant gravitational acceleration, speed gt.

questions.text: Uniform circular motion has speed 4 m/s and radius 2 m. Find centripetal acceleration in m/s².
questions.explanation: Centripetal acceleration is v²/r.

questions.text: Two vehicles move in the same direction at 12 and 6 m/s. Find the faster vehicle's speed relative to the slower in m/s.
questions.explanation: Relative velocity in the same direction is the difference of velocities.

questions.text: A constant 20 N force acts parallel to a displacement of 3 m. Find its work in joules.
questions.explanation: W=Fd cosθ and θ=0.

questions.text: A 2 kg object is raised vertically by 3 m at constant speed. What is the work done by gravity in joules? Use g=10 m/s².
questions.explanation: Gravity opposes upward displacement, so Wgravity=−mgh.

questions.text: A 2 kg object initially at rest reaches 4 m/s. What is the net work in joules?
questions.explanation: Net work equals the change in kinetic energy, mv²/2.

questions.text: A machine performs 240 J of work in 6 s. Find its average power in watts.
questions.explanation: Average power is work divided by elapsed time.

questions.text: A 2 kg object moves at 6 m/s. What is its kinetic energy in joules?
questions.explanation: Kinetic energy is mv²/2.

questions.text: An object falls from rest through 10 m without losses. Find its speed squared in m²/s², using g=10 m/s².
questions.explanation: Conservation of energy gives v²=2gh.

questions.text: A machine receives 200 J and delivers 120 J of useful output. What is its efficiency as a percentage?
questions.explanation: Efficiency = useful output / input ×100%.

questions.text: A net force of 24 N acts on a 6 kg mass. Find acceleration in m/s².
questions.explanation: Newton's second law gives a=Fnet/m.

questions.text: A body rests on a horizontal surface with normal force 200 N. If μk=0.2, find kinetic friction in newtons when it slides.
questions.explanation: Kinetic friction magnitude is μkN.

questions.text: A spring with k=200 N/m is extended by 0.1 m. Find the restoring force magnitude in newtons.
questions.explanation: Hooke's law gives |F|=k|x|.

questions.text: A 2 kg body hangs motionless from a light vertical rope. Find tension in newtons, using g=10 m/s².
questions.explanation: Equilibrium requires tension to balance weight.

questions.text: A 2 kg object's velocity changes from +3 to −2 m/s. What is its change in momentum in kg·m/s?
questions.explanation: Δp=m(vfinal−vinitial)=m(−2−3).

questions.text: The separation of two point masses becomes 2 times as large. By what factor does their gravitational force change?
questions.explanation: Newtonian gravitation has an inverse-square dependence on separation.

questions.text: A 2 kg mass moves at 4 m/s around a circle of radius 2 m. What net inward force is required in newtons?
questions.explanation: Fcentripetal=mv²/r.

questions.text: Which description best matches an ordinary solid under normal conditions?
options: Shape and volume both independent of state
questions.explanation: The particle model distinguishes rigidity, fluidity and compressibility.

questions.text: A perpendicular force of 120 N acts on 0.2 m². Find pressure in pascals.
questions.explanation: Pressure is normal force divided by area.

questions.text: A sample has mass 2 kg and volume 0.002 m³. Find its density in kg/m³.
questions.explanation: Density is mass divided by volume.

questions.text: A 2 kg object rests on a horizontal base of area 0.02 m². Find its pressure on the base, using g=10 m/s².
questions.explanation: The force on the base is mg and pressure is mg/A.

questions.text: Find the gauge pressure at depth 0.2 m in water of density 1000 kg/m³, using g=10 m/s².
questions.explanation: Hydrostatic gauge pressure is ρgh.

questions.text: A mercury column has height 2 cm. Use ρHg=13600 kg/m³ and g=10 m/s². What pressure does it represent in pascals?
questions.explanation: Convert centimetres to metres before applying ρgh.

questions.text: A liquid creates 2000 Pa of pressure above the pressure outside a flat base of area 0.02 m². Find the net pressure force in newtons.
questions.explanation: Pressure force due to a pressure difference is Δp A.

questions.text: A hydraulic press has output piston area 2 times the input area. An input force of 50 N gives what ideal output force in newtons?
questions.explanation: Equal fluid pressures imply Fout/Fin=Aout/Ain.

questions.text: A measurement is taken 1000 m higher in the atmosphere. All else being typical, atmospheric pressure:
options: Increases in direct proportion to altitude
questions.explanation: There is less overlying air at higher altitude, so atmospheric pressure is lower.

questions.text: An open water manometer has a 2 cm level difference. Find the pressure difference in pascals with ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=10 m/s².
questions.explanation: Use Δp=ρgΔh with height in metres.

questions.text: An ideal barometer's fluid density doubles while the atmospheric pressure stays fixed. If its original height was 40 cm, what is its new height in cm?
questions.explanation: Patm=ρgh, so at fixed pressure height is inversely proportional to density.

questions.text: Absolute pressure is 120 kPa and local atmospheric pressure is 100 kPa. Find gauge pressure in kPa.
questions.explanation: Gauge pressure = absolute pressure − atmospheric pressure.

questions.text: An object displaces 0.002 m³ of water. Find the buoyant force in newtons, using ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=10 m/s².
questions.explanation: Archimedes' principle gives Fbuoyant=ρfluid g Vdisplaced.

questions.text: An incompressible steady flow has inlet area 2 times its outlet area. If inlet speed is 2 m/s, find outlet speed in m/s.
questions.explanation: Continuity requires A1v1=A2v2.

questions.text: A gas absorbs 200 J of heat and does 50 J of work on its surroundings. Find ΔU in joules.
questions.explanation: With Wby positive for work done by the gas, ΔU=Q−Wby.

questions.text: A gas absorbs 200 J in an isochoric process. Find ΔU in joules.
questions.explanation: Fixed volume gives W=0, so ΔU=Q.

questions.text: An ideal gas expands isothermally from volume 2 L to 4 L. If its initial pressure is 120 kPa, find its final pressure in kPa.
questions.explanation: At constant temperature, P1V1=P2V2.

questions.text: A gas expands isobarically at 200 kPa by 2 litres. Find work done by the gas in joules.
questions.explanation: Wby=PΔV and 1 kPa·L = 1 J.

questions.text: A gas receives 200 J of work during an adiabatic compression. Find ΔU in joules.
questions.explanation: An adiabatic process has Q=0; work done on the gas increases its internal energy.

questions.text: In a isochoric process, which quantity must be zero?
questions.explanation: Isochoric implies ΔV=0; ideal-gas isothermal implies ΔU=0; adiabatic implies Q=0.

questions.text: A heat engine absorbs 1000 J and rejects 200 J per cycle. Find efficiency as a percentage.
questions.explanation: Efficiency=(Qhot−Qcold)/Qhot.

questions.text: A refrigerator removes 200 J from its interior using 100 J of work. Find its coefficient of performance.
questions.explanation: COPrefrigerator=Qcold/Win.

questions.text: A 2 kg material with specific heat 500 J/(kg·K) warms by 4 K without changing phase. Find heat absorbed in joules.
questions.explanation: Use Q=mcΔT for a temperature change within one phase.

questions.text: A neutral conductor loses 2 electrons. Its net charge is:

questions.text: A positive test charge of 2 C feels a 20 N force. Find the electric field magnitude in N/C.

questions.text: A charge of 24 C passes a cross-section in 4 s. Find current in amperes.

questions.text: Why can a gas be compressed much more than a liquid?

There is much more empty space between gas particles

No net movement despite the concentration difference

questions.explanation: List gametes and combine them in a Punnett square. A dominant phenotype requires at least one A allele.

questions.text: Producers contain 2000 kJ available energy. If 10% transfers to primary consumers, how much energy reaches those consumers in kJ?
questions.explanation: With an explicitly given 10% transfer efficiency, multiply the preceding trophic level's energy by 0.1.

questions.text: After a meal, blood glucose rises from its fasting level by 2 units. Which hormone normally promotes glucose uptake and storage?
questions.explanation: Pancreatic beta cells secrete insulin in response to raised glucose; its effects help lower blood glucose.

questions.text: A 30 g sample melts at constant temperature. Its latent heat of fusion is 200 J/g. How much heat is absorbed, in joules?
questions.explanation: At a phase-change plateau, Q=mL; temperature does not rise until the phase change finishes.

questions.text: Which change produces new chemical substances in example 2?
questions.explanation: Rusting, combustion and souring involve chemical changes; the other listed processes do not change chemical identity.

questions.text: A liquid flows but nearly keeps its volume. Which particle-level model explains this?
options: Particles remain close but can slide past one another
Particles occupy fixed lattice positions only
questions.explanation: A liquid combines close particle spacing with mobility.

questions.text: Choose the appropriate separation method for two miscible liquids with different boiling points.
questions.explanation: Choose by physical properties: insoluble particle size, boiling-point difference, or removal of the solvent.

questions.text: In a closed system, 30 g of A reacts completely with 15 g of B to form only C. Find the mass of C in grams.
questions.explanation: Conservation of mass in a closed system gives mass of products equal to total mass of reactants.

questions.text: A neutral atom has atomic number 8. How many protons does it have?
questions.explanation: The atomic number is the proton number. Neutrality additionally makes electron number equal to proton number.

questions.text: An animal cell and its surrounding solution are isotonic. What is true of water movement?
options: Water moves both ways with no net flux
No water molecule crosses the membrane
questions.explanation: At osmotic equilibrium the bidirectional fluxes balance, rather than molecular movement stopping.

questions.text: A plant cell loses water in a hypertonic solution. Which change is expected?
options: Water moves against its gradient without energy
The membrane can pull away from the cell wall
The cell necessarily bursts from water entry
questions.explanation: Osmotic loss of water reduces turgor and may produce plasmolysis.

questions.text: Given P→Q and not Q, which conclusion is valid?
questions.explanation: Modus tollens: if P held then Q would hold, contradicting not Q.

questions.text: What is the negation of 'Every student solved at least one exercise'?
options: Some students solved at least one exercise
At least one student solved no exercises
questions.explanation: Negating ∀x∃y P(x,y) gives ∃x∀y not P(x,y).

questions.text: Sales rose from 80 to 100 units. What was the percentage increase?
questions.explanation: Percentage change uses the original value as denominator: (100−80)/80×100=25%.

questions.text: Premises: Every class member passed the exam. Tom is a class member. Tom did not pass the exam. Is this set consistent?
options: Yes, because Tom might be absent
Yes, because universal claims have no exceptions
No; it entails both 'Tom passed' and 'Tom did not pass'
questions.explanation: Instantiating the universal premise with Tom yields a direct contradiction.
